title: Coursebuilder Unit File
description: Schema for a single unit JSON file. One file per unit/chapter. The generic assembly script reads all unit files from a folder and produces the final CSV + XML pair.

unit_number.description: Sequential unit number (0 for intro/welcome, 1+ for content units)

unit_name.description: Short name used as the Moodle section title. E.g. 'Introduction', 'Unit 1', 'Unit 2'

section_name.description: Full display title. E.g. 'Unit 1: Python Basics: Variables, Data Types & Operators'

tag.description: Short code prefix for question names in XML. E.g. '[PY1]', '[INT]', '[MAT2]'

description.description: Brief summary of learning objectives for this unit (plain text)

lessons.description: Array of lesson pages for this unit. Minimum 1, typically 3.

title.description: Lesson display name. E.g. 'Core Concepts: Variables & Data Types'

html_content.description: Full HTML content for the lesson page body. Must be single-line HTML. Use semantic tags (h3, p, ul, li, strong, code, pre). No inline CSS styling.

title.description: Quiz activity name in Moodle. Must include the unit number and topic keywords for auto-mapping. E.g. 'Unit 1 Quiz — Python Basics'

category_name.description: XML category suffix used in the path: $course$/top/[CourseName] / [section_name] / [category_name]. Must include unit number and topic keywords matching the quiz title. E.g. 'Unit 1 - Python Basics'

grade.description: Max grade points for the quiz. Default: 50

questions.description: Array of multiple-choice questions. Typically 5 per unit.

instructions.description: HTML instructions for the assignment. Include rubric table if applicable.

prompt.description: Discussion prompt text (plain text or simple HTML)
